title.narrative: Governance in Justice Sector Reform Program - Subprogram 2

description.narrative: The GJSRP was designed to address weaknesses in the judiciary and justice sector institutions that arise due in large part to inadequate resources—a situation exacerbated by weak financial management. The impact of subprogram 2 will be greater public trust and confidence in the justice system. The outcome will be a more efficient justice sector.
